activity.notes: Victor Emmanuel II became King of Sardinia in 1849 after Charles Albert abdicated and remained king of the Sardinian-Piedmontese monarchy until the Kingdom of Italy was proclaimed in 1861. ATLAS separates this pre-unification kingship from his 1861-1878 kingship of Italy.

sources.title: Victor-Emmanuel II — Ministère des Armées
sources.citation_text: The French Ministry of the Armed Forces identifies Victor Emmanuel II as King of Sardinia from 1849 before becoming the first King of Italy in 1861.
